This notice explains how HAYKALAH handles personal data on haykalah.com, under the Saudi Personal Data Protection Law (PDPL).

  • We collect personal data only when you send it to us: a request, a newsletter sign-up, an event registration or an email.
  • Nothing is tracked before you choose. Google Analytics loads only if you select “Accept analytics”, and “Reject” is offered just as clearly.
  • Ask HAYKALAH (Beta) stores no personal data. Questions are logged anonymously.
  • You can ask to see, correct or delete your data, or withdraw your consent, by email.

01Who is responsible for your data

The controller of your personal data is HAYKALAH Financial Advisory, Commercial Registration No. 7014123751, with offices in Riyadh and Jeddah, Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

Email
haykalah@haykalah.com
Website
haykalah.com

02What we collect

Requests and consultations

When you send a request from the Contact page or the homepage, we receive the details you enter: your name, work email, country, who you are (for example a family office or a bank), what you need, and your message. Organization, role, phone, city and the goals you tick are optional. We also record whether you asked for an NDA first, your consent, the language of the page and the page you sent it from. Please keep confidential details out of the form until an NDA is in place.

The Structuring Brief

If you subscribe, we receive your email address and your consent. Every subscription is confirmed by a second email (double opt-in), and every issue has an unsubscribe link.

Events

If you register for a roundtable or event, we receive the details the registration form asks for.

Analytics, only with your consent

If you select “Accept analytics”, Google Analytics 4 records how the site is used: for example the pages you view, how you arrived, and your device, browser and approximate location. If you select “Reject”, or make no choice, Google Analytics does not load and nothing is sent to Google. Advertising features stay switched off in either case. Analytics data is kept only as long as needed to understand how the site is used.

Ask HAYKALAH (Beta)

Ask HAYKALAH answers questions from HAYKALAH’s published pages. It does not ask for your name or email and stores no personal data. The questions you type are sent to an AI provider (Anthropic, whose Claude models generate the answers) to produce the answer, and are logged anonymously, with personal data removed, so that we can improve the answers. Please do not type personal or confidential information into it.

Email

If you email haykalah@haykalah.com, we receive your address, your message and any attachments.

Technical data

To deliver the website and keep it secure, our hosting provider processes technical data such as IP addresses and browser information. Our hosting provider keeps technical logs for security and reliability, for a limited period.

Downloading the credentials pack does not require any personal details.

04Who receives it

  • The HAYKALAH team that handles your request.
  • Service providers that process data for us under our instructions:
    • GitHub, Inc. (United States), whose GitHub Pages service hosts the website.
    • Web3Forms (servers in the United States), which receives the forms on this website, emails them to us and keeps a copy in our account with it.
    • The email service we use to send the Structuring Brief.
    • Anthropic PBC (United States), whose Claude models generate Ask HAYKALAH’s answers.
    • Google, for Google Analytics, only if you accept analytics.
  • Authorities, where the law requires us to disclose data.

05Transfers outside the Kingdom

GitHub, Web3Forms, our email service, the AI provider behind Ask HAYKALAH and Google process data outside the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. We transfer personal data abroad only as the PDPL and its regulations allow.

07Your rights

Under the PDPL you have rights over your personal data. They include the right to:

  • be told how your data is collected and used, as this notice does;
  • access your data and receive a copy of it;
  • ask us to correct data that is inaccurate or incomplete;
  • ask us to delete data we no longer need;
  • withdraw your consent at any time, without affecting what was done before.

You can also complain to the competent authority, the Saudi Data & AI Authority (SDAIA).

08How to exercise your rights

Email haykalah@haykalah.com with the subject “Personal data request”. Tell us what you would like us to do, and which form or email the request relates to. We may ask you to confirm your identity before we act. We respond within the period the PDPL requires.

To stop the Structuring Brief, use the unsubscribe link in any issue. To change your analytics choice, use “Cookie settings” at the foot of any page.

09Cookies and similar storage

We use a small number of cookies and browser-storage items. Analytics cookies are set only after you select “Accept analytics”. You can change your choice at any time with “Cookie settings” at the foot of any page. If you change to “Reject”, analytics stops and the analytics cookies are deleted from this site.

Ask HAYKALAH sets no cookies and stores nothing in your browser.

You can also block or delete cookies in your browser settings. The site still works without them; it will ask for your analytics choice again and may not remember your language.

10Security

The site is served over an encrypted connection (HTTPS). Access to requests and subscriber lists is limited to the people who handle them. No method of sending data over the internet is completely secure, so please keep confidential details out of web forms until an NDA is in place.

11Changes to this notice

We will update this notice when our practices or the law change, and show the date of the latest version at the top of this page. If we make material changes, we will update the date at the top of this notice.

12Questions

Does Ask HAYKALAH store what I type?

Questions are logged anonymously, with personal data removed, so that we can improve the answers. Ask HAYKALAH does not ask for your name or email. Please do not type personal or confidential information into it.

Can I use the site without analytics cookies?

Yes. Select “Reject”, or make no choice, and Google Analytics does not load. Every page works the same way.

How do I unsubscribe from the Structuring Brief?

Use the unsubscribe link in any issue, or email haykalah@haykalah.com.
